# SnapCV

> SnapCV is a free, open-source tool that turns a résumé or a GitHub username into a hosted personal portfolio and résumé at yourname.snapcv.me. It is built for job seekers, students, and professionals who want a clean, shareable professional page without designing or coding one.

## What it does
- Turns an uploaded résumé (PDF) into a structured, editable portfolio using AI.
- Builds a portfolio directly from a GitHub username: ranked repositories, AI-written recruiter-legible project descriptions, languages as skills, and a contribution activity graph.
- Hosts each portfolio on its own subdomain (yourname.snapcv.me) with a matching, ATS-friendly résumé page and one-click PDF export.
- Generates social share cards (Open Graph) for every portfolio link.

## Key facts
- Price: free.
- License: AGPL-3.0 (open source).
- Source code: https://github.com/jamaljm/snapcv
- Primary site: https://snapcv.me
- Try without signing up: https://snapcv.me/try

## How to create a portfolio
1. Go to https://snapcv.me and sign in, or preview instantly at https://snapcv.me/try
2. Start from a résumé PDF or a GitHub username.
3. Edit the generated content, pick a color, and publish.
4. Share your link: yourname.snapcv.me

## Good for
- "resume to portfolio" / "resume to website"
- "GitHub profile to portfolio"
- "free portfolio builder for developers and students"
- "read.cv alternative" (https://snapcv.me/read-cv-alternative)
